traced.number: 32.9% ordinary nominal-95% interval coverage after selecting among 64 independent equal-accuracy candidates on 128 questions
traced.computes: The code averages whether the ordinary Clopper–Pearson interval for the randomly tie-broken maximum count contains 0.3 over 4,000 repetitions with 64 independent Bernoulli candidates and 128 observations, yielding 0.3285 as the paper states after rounding.

traced.number: 4.7 percentage points mean optimism for the 24-candidate, 128-question empirical-population replay
traced.computes: The code draws 128 rows with replacement from the 1,024 development rows in each of 4,000 repetitions, selects the highest-scoring candidate, and averages its selection accuracy minus its full development-column mean, yielding 0.046937744140625 for the paper's explicitly conditional replay target.

traced.number: +1.6 percentage points locked-audit gain over the fixed baseline, with conservative 95% interval [-2.7, 5.9] percentage points
traced.computes: After checking the frozen candidate chosen on the first 128 development rows, the code computes (111 candidate-only wins minus 95 baseline-only wins)/1,024 on the separate audit rows and subtracts Bonferroni-adjusted exact binomial discordance intervals, matching the reported gain and conservative interval.

traced.number: 83.95% ordinary nominal-95% Wilson coverage in the primary equal-quality simulation
traced.computes: For 2,000 generated datasets with eight marginal-0.7 candidates, latent correlation 0.5 and 64 selection items, the code selects the first maximum sample mean and counts whether its unadjusted Wilson interval contains its known population accuracy, yielding 0.8395 as stated.

traced.number: 2.32 percentage points mean selection optimism relative to the real fixed cohort
traced.computes: Across 2,000 uniform permutations of the 600 cached rows, the code selects among eight candidates using the first 64 rows and averages the selected sample mean minus that candidate's mean over all 600 rows, yielding 0.023171354166666668 for the stated cohort rather than fresh-population target.

traced.number: 96.35% exact-audit coverage for selected-candidate accuracy on the real fixed cohort
traced.computes: The code inverts hypergeometric tails for 128 audit items drawn from the 536 unselected rows, maps the remainder interval to cohort accuracy using the known 64-row selection contribution, and counts coverage of the selected full-column mean across 2,000 repetitions, yielding the stated 0.9635.
